values.meaning: maximum graves that can exist at once
values.quote: Up to 4 ''graves'' can exist at once

values.meaning: delay before graves raise into Mist Walkers
values.quote: raise 1 {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} from each ''grave'' after a 1-second delay
Up to 4 {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} can be active at once

mechanics.claim: A grave is raised where Yorick scores a killing blow with Last Rites, or where he damages an enemy champion or large monster with it.
mechanics.quote: Whenever '''Yorick''' uses ''{{ai|Last Rites|Yorick}}'' to score the killing blow on any enemy or damage an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, he raises a ''grave''

mechanics.claim: Damaging a large monster or champion with Last Rites spawns only 1 grave even if it kills them, avoiding a double grave.
mechanics.quote: Damaging a large monster or champion with {{ai|Last Rites|Yorick}} will only spawn 1 grave, even if it kills them.

mechanics.claim: Yorick can consume graves via Awakening (R) or the Mourning Mist (E) mark to raise Mist Walkers after a 1-second delay.
mechanics.quote: '''Yorick''' can use ''{{ai|Awakening|Yorick}}'' and ''{{ais|Mourning Mist|Yorick}}'' mark to raise 1 {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} from each ''grave'' after a 1-second delay, consuming the ''graves'' in the process.

mechanics.claim: The newest Mist Walker replaces the nearest one once the 4-Mist Walker cap is exceeded.
mechanics.quote: with the nearest one always being replaced by the newest upon raising one over the limit
